==Description==
The '''Slime''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]] as part of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. It had less health than the [[Reanimated]], but had an average walk speed. When it died, a small slime bubble would be made, which would spawn two [[Goo (Trick or Threat Town)|Goo]]s.

The '''Slime''' could be spawned by [[Lord Sinister]].

==Appearance==
The '''Slime''' was a completely lime green faceless enemy. All of its body parts were encased in a slime capsule which was slightly translucent. Goo particles were emitted from its body. It was larger than the [[Undead (Trick or Threat Town)|Undead]].

==Strategy==
*The [[Goo (Trick or Threat Town)|Goo]]s that the '''Slime''' splits into are very quick. Make sure to deal with these enemies.
**The [[Turret]] deals high damage and has long range, so can perform well against the '''Slime''' and the [[Goo (Trick or Threat Town)|Goo]]s that spawn.
**The [[Ranger]] and [[Military Base]]'s [[units]] can also work well against the '''Slime'''.
***These towers are best paired with the [[Commander]] as it boosts their firerate.
*If a '''Slime''' is near the end of the path, try not to kill it, if it is at low health. When it is killed, it will spawn into two [[Goo (Trick or Threat Town)|Goo]]s which will result in a defeat.

==Trivia==
*The '''Slime''' behaved very similar to the [[Splitter (Polluted Wasteland)|Splitter]].
**However, the '''Slime''' did not stun towers when it died.
*The '''Slime''' may be a reference to the [https://minecraft.wiki/w/Slime Slime] from ''Minecraft''.
*The '''Slime''' was inspired by the [[w:c:evolution-evade:Slime|Slime]] from ''Evolution Evade''.
**Its mechanics were similar to the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Slime|Slime]] from ''Tower Battles''.
